A '''town''' was located in the [[planet]] [[Lau]].<ref name="Trivia Gallery" /> It included a [[Lau spaceport|spaceport]], where [[Star Commuter 2000]] [[shuttle]]s ferried passengers<ref name="Different" /> to the planet,<ref name="Trivia Gallery Star Commuter">{{SW|url=series/the-bad-batch/a-different-approach-episode-guide|text="A Different Approach" Episode Guide | The Bad Batch}} {{C|Slide 2}}</ref> as well as a [[cargo docks|cargo port]].<ref name="Different" />

During or after [[18 BBY]],<ref name="Date">{{TBBDate|304}}</ref> the town was controlled by the [[Galactic Empire]], with [[Captain]] [[Mann]] leading the [[TK stormtrooper]] forces patrolling the streets. During that time, [[Crosshair]] and [[Omega]], on the run from the [[Advanced Science Division]], crash-landed to the planet on board a [[Rho-class transport shuttle|''Rho''-class transport shuttle]] and sought refuge in the town.<ref name="Different" />

In order to make enough money to bribe [[Unidentified ticketing agent|a ticketing agent]] to let them in the spaceport, Omega decided to gamble in [[Unidentified cantina (Lau)|a cantina]], where she ultimately defeated a [[Unidentified Trandoshan (Lau)|Trandoshan patron]] in the game of [[balaans]]. While preparing to leave, she was stopped by Mann, who asked her for another game. When she defeated him as well, Mann forced her to pay a "fine" for gambling, in order to take back what he had lost. He also kidnapped Omega's pet [[lurca hound]], [[Batcher]], and took it to the [[cargo docks]], expecting Omega to show up to retrieve it. When she did, Mann announced his intentions to arrest her and Crosshair, as their status as fugitives had been discovered, but Crosshair engaged the troopers in a firefight giving Omega enough time to open the cages of several animals held in the dock, trampling the troopers and giving the duo time to escape.<ref name="Different" />
